todos: [P1] AUDIT-IPC-CONTRACT-DEPTH-01: next, align agent:start-task's runtime schema in electron/core/presentation/secureIpcMain.ts with the real payload from src/hooks/useCodingAgent.ts and give IElectronAPI.startAgentTask a concrete shared request type instead of unknown. The current schema checks only userTask and agentMode; identity, sessionId, workspacePath, capabilityProfile, settings, files and documents pass through. Audit other passthrough/JSON schemas against consumers, add negative contract tests, and retain the 96-channel registration guard (7 unused channels were removed on 2026-09-23). Then run npm run quality:static, targeted IPC tests, typecheck and Electron E2E.

[P2] SETTINGS-BOOTSTRAP-FAILURE-01: next, handle settings:get rejection in src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx with a recoverable bootstrap state that cannot overwrite persisted settings. The current catch leaves settingsReady false and stops automatic diagnostics. Extend scripts/e2e/settingsBootstrap.mjs to test rejection and prove real settings.json precedence before replacing the IPC handler; the current stub returns the same values as the file. Run npm run test:e2e:settings-bootstrap and the fast suite after the fix.

[P2] OLLAMA-THINKING-GPTOSS-LIVE-01: GPT-OSS was absent from the configured Ollama host on 2026-09-23. When available, re-read the configured host and model inventory, verify its actual family/capabilities and app behavior, confirm Settings shows only the level-only compatibility note (no false off switch), and confirm the runtime remains usable with the documented think:false default. Unit coverage is complete; this live check is still pending.

[P2] AGENT-GUARD-CONSOLIDATION-01: next, instrument which guard fires per run in npm run test:e2e:electron and npm run test:live, then merge the overlapping loop/stagnation/redundant-write/rejection mechanisms (loopDetector, loopEscapePolicy, stagnationCircuitBreaker, redundantWriteDetector, toolRejectionEscalation, recoveryBudget and the seven streak counters in agentOrchestratorResponseInterpreterTypes.ts/stagnationCircuitBreaker.ts) into one model-agnostic progress policy with a single budget. Keep OOM, timeout, anomaly, loop and eviction safeguards; prove parity on the 8 Electron E2E scenarios before deleting modules.

[P2] RENDERER-HOOK-SPLIT-01: next, split src/hooks/useCodingAgent.ts (959 lines, 21 useState, ~104 returned fields passed whole as prop `c: ReturnType<typeof useCodingAgent>` to CodingAgentLeftPanel/CodingEditorContent) into session, execution, terminal and attachment hooks with explicit prop interfaces; merge the near-duplicate useDocumentTranslation/useInplaceTranslation state in src/hooks/useTranslation.ts. Verify with npm run test:e2e:electron and npm run test:e2e:bundle-ux.

[P2] SIDECAR-OCR-ENGINE-INIT-RACE-01: sidecar/infrastructure/ocr.py::_get_rapidocr_engine initializes the global _RAPIDOCR_ENGINE lazily without a lock, while PDF pages render on a 3-thread pool (PDF_PAGE_RENDER_CONCURRENCY in ingest_service.py), so concurrent first pages can build two engines. Next, guard initialization with a threading.Lock (double-checked) and add a pytest that calls it from several threads and asserts one construction.

[P2] ARCH-LAYERING-01: Main application services still import electron directly (9 files, e.g. sidecarAppService.ts, systemAppService.ts, taskQueueAppService.ts), about 12 call webContents.send, 12 use node:fs instead of repositories, and electron/diagnostics.ts (logger + Ollama probe + nvidia-smi + report) is imported by ~56 core files. Next, introduce a renderer-event port and a logger module separate from diagnostics.ts, move fs access behind existing repositories, and keep npm run audit:cycles clean.

[P3] FORMAT-BASELINE-01: 466 of 693 files drift from biome.json formatting because quality:static formats only newly added files. Next, land one formatting-only commit (npx biome format --write src electron shared scripts), then make check_static_quality.mjs format-check every file.

[P3] HTTP-METRICS-SURFACE-OR-REMOVE-01: httpMetrics is recorded by webClient, ollamaHttpClient and agentStreamTransport but nothing reads it since the unused diagnostics:get-http-metrics IPC was removed; next, either show it in DiagnosticsDrawer or delete electron/core/infrastructure/http/httpMetrics.ts, its record() call sites, diagnosticsAppService.getHttpMetrics and their tests.

[P3] DOCUMENTS-LIST-PAYLOAD-01: GET /documents returns the full extracted_markdown of every document and useIngestedDocuments refetches it on every window focus and tab change; next, return metadata only from the list and load a document's markdown on demand (chat context, attach, translation).

[P3] SIDECAR-TRANSLATION-CANCEL-01: the translation stream has no task_id or cooperative cancellation (ingestion does); next, add task_id to TranslateInplaceRequest, check raise_if_cancelled between PDF pages/DOCX batches in sidecar/domain/translator.py, and wire cancellation from sidecarHttpClient.translateDocumentInplaceStream.

[P3] I18N-HARDCODED-STRINGS-01: ~30 hardcoded Italian UI strings remain in src (e.g. AppLayout.tsx, ChatView.tsx, useCodingAgent.ts), 14 in Main core services, and sidecar progress/chunk-prefix text is Italian-only (the '[Documento: … | Sezione: …]' prefix is also embedded); next, move UI strings to src/i18n locales and make sidecar progress messages locale-neutral codes.

[P3] MODEL-FALLBACK-CONSISTENCY-01: hardcoded model fallbacks disagree: 'qwen2.5-coder:7b' in agentInterviewAppService.ts, agentOrchestratorPromptAssembly.ts, agentOrchestratorSessionContext.ts, planGenerationAppService.ts versus 'llama3.2' in agentOrchestratorSessionSetup.ts::buildDefaultAgentSettings and ollamaHttpClient.ts, while DEFAULT_APP_SETTINGS.defaultModel is ''. Next, resolve a missing model in one shared function that fails with a clear 'no model configured' error instead of guessing a model that may not be installed.

[P3] RENDERER-PERF-01: ChatView.tsx renders messages without virtualization while useChatEngine re-maps the whole list every 40 ms during streaming; DiagnosticsDrawer polls full logs every 2.5 s with key={index}; PromptConfigurationModal tokenizes the whole draft on every keystroke and tokenEstimate.ts caches up to 1000 full drafts; monacoTheme.ts imports all of monaco-editor (ts.worker 6.9 MB). Next, memoize/virtualize the chat list, cap the token cache by size, debounce the token label, and load only the Monaco languages in use; verify with npm run test:e2e:bundle-ux.

[P3] LINT-STRICTNESS-01: biome.json lint uses preset none (only correctness + 3 suspicious rules); there are ~327 `any` in Main and ~130 in the renderer (97 are `catch (err: any)`), plus two inert `eslint-disable` comments (ESLint is not installed) in useAgentTimelineScroll.ts and useSkillHubModal.ts. After FORMAT-BASELINE-01, enable noExplicitAny as a warning, replace `catch (err: any)` with unknown + errorNormalizer, and delete the eslint-disable comments.

[P3] TOOLING-TYPECHECK-SCOPE-01: tsconfig.json includes scripts/live but not scripts/e2e, so scripts/e2e/sidecarOwnership.live.ts is never typechecked; vitest.sidecar.config.mts lacks the '@' alias used by the other configs. Next, add scripts/e2e to tsconfig include (fixing any errors) and align the config.

[P3] SIDECAR-DEAD-PATHS-01: after the 2026-09-23 endpoint cleanup, VocabSyncService's remote path (allow_remote=True, raw.githubusercontent.com manifest) is reachable only from tests, and process_and_index_document_generator still carries the upload-bytes branch (content/EXPORT_DIR caching) although every caller passes a file path with empty content. Next, remove both paths and their tests, keep bundled vocabulary loading, and regenerate the OpenAPI contract if schemas change.

[P3] SIDECAR-ERROR-DETAIL-01: sidecar/main.py still answers several 500s with HTTPException(detail=str(e)) (ingest-path-stream start, PUT /documents, page preview, delete, history index, export, logs analyze), which can include local paths. The API is now token-protected, so the exposure is limited to Main; next, return a generic message with the error_id used by global_exception_handler and log the detail.
